items.label: Include Script
items.content:
# Include the AIClient Library

Use the following script tag to load the AIClient library in a browser environment.

`html
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/HyperRushNet/hrn-ai/client/1.0.3.min.js"></script>
`

## Behavior
- Defines a global `AIClient` class.
- No module system required.
- Must be included before any client usage.

items.label: Initialize Client
items.content:
# Initialize AIClient

Create a new instance and set your API key.

`javascript
const client = new AIClient().setApiKey('YOUR_API_KEY');
`

## Internal Defaults
| Property | Default |
|---------|--------|
| model | flux |
| type | text |
| systemPrompt | 'You are a helpful assistant.' |
| timeout | 30000 |
| retry | true |
| retryAttempts | 2 |
| retryDelay | 1000 |
| seed | null |
| width | 1024 |
| height | 1024 |
| history | empty array |

## Notes
- API key is mandatory; requests without it will throw an error.

items.label: Set Text Mode
items.content:
# Set Type to Text

`javascript
client.setType('text');
`

## Behavior
- Only 'image' is treated differently; all other values resolve to 'text'.
- Enables chat completion endpoint `/v1/chat/completions`.

items.label: Select Text Model
items.content:
# Set Model

`javascript
client.setModel('gemini-fast');
`

## Behavior
- The model string is sent directly to the API.
- No validation occurs in the client.
- Text models must have text output; otherwise, the API returns an error.

items.label: Generate Text
items.content:
# Generate Text

`javascript
const output = await client.generate('Explain AIClient usage');
console.log(output);
`

## Behavior
- Sends `systemPrompt` + history + user prompt.
- Stores messages in internal history.
- Trims history if length > 2 * historyLimit.

## Error Conditions
| Condition | Error |
|-----------|-------|
| Missing API key | Throws 'API Key is required' |
| Empty prompt | Throws 'Input prompt cannot be empty' |
| API returns 429 or 5xx | Retries if retry=true, up to retryAttempts |

children.label: System Prompt
children.content:
# System Prompt

`javascript
client.setSystemPrompt('You are a helpful assistant.');
`

- Added as first message for every request.
- Default: 'You are a helpful assistant.'

children.label: Timeout
children.content:
# Timeout

`javascript
client.setTimeout(30000);
`

- Maximum wait in milliseconds.
- Uses AbortController to cancel request.
- Throws 'AI Request Timeout' on abort.

children.label: Seed
children.content:
# Seed

`javascript
client.setSeed(12345);
`

- Numeric value for deterministic outputs.
- Defaults to random 0–1,000,000,000 if not set.

children.label: Retry Logic
children.content:
# Retry Logic

`javascript
client.setRetry(true, 2, 1000);
`

- Retries only for 429 or 5xx status codes.
- Parameters: enabled (bool), attempts (number), delay (ms).

children.label: Clear History
children.content:
# Clear History

`javascript
client.clearHistory();
`

- Clears internal chat history array.

items.label: Set Image Mode
items.content:
# Set Type to Image

`javascript
client.setType('image');
`

- Enables image generation endpoint `/v1/images/generations`.

items.label: Select Image Model
items.content:
# Set Model

`javascript
client.setModel('flux');
`

- Only models with image output are compatible.

items.label: Image Dimensions
items.content:
# Set Dimensions

`javascript
client.setDimensions(1024, 1024);
`

- Width and height in pixels.
- Defaults: 1024 x 1024.
- Non-numeric values revert to defaults.

items.label: Generate Image
Overview
items.content:
# Model Overview

- AIClient does not validate models.
- All strings are passed to the API.
- Text models must have text output; image models must have image output.

## Usage
`javascript
client.setModel('gemini-fast');
`

## Compatibility Rules
| Client Type | Required Model Output |
|------------|----------------------|
| text | text |
| image | image |
